name: v2-scara-lines
review: For the firmware's default 150 mm equal arms and (100,-60) mm offset, independent two-link inverse kinematics predicts the initial and all commanded endpoint motor angles within 0.5 step at 80 steps/degree; the final steps are (1329,10294,0). At 100 mm/s^2 and F1500 (25 mm/s), the source-defined junction deviation gives approximately 10.56 mm/s at the first turn and 3.474 mm/s at each right-angle turn. Continuous profiles predict all five durations within 0.17% of the trace. The simulator documents an unequal-arm discrepancy; this equal-arm case does not validate that geometry or physical timing.
